[[Spirit of the Fallen|Spirits of the Fallen]] are [[undead]] foes encountered in [[Nolani Academy]]. They have the appearance of translucent [[Ascalonian Guard]]/[[Ascalonian Soldier|Soldiers]].

==Missions==
*[[Ascalon]]
**{{NPC location|Nolani Academy}}

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Hamstring}}
*{{skill icon|Final Thrust}}
*{{skill icon|Skull Crack}} ([[elite]], [[Hard Mode]] only)
*{{monster skill icon|Undead sensitivity to Light}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Ghostly Remains]]

==Notes==
*Be wary of these spirits, their large numbers, relatively high level, and [[Crippled|crippling]] ability can easily [[wipe]] a low-level [[party]] if not handled correctly.
*Some spirits remain stationary instead of [[patrol]]ling. These do not fight back unless attacked in [[melee]].
*Unlike most ghosts, [[holy damage]] is doubled against Spirits of the Fallen.
